_readme: Add a series by adding an entry here — no new script needed.
Run one source:  MODE=discover python scripts/fetch.py NAME   (dump real structure first)
Providers: fred (any FRED id) | eurostat (any dataset+params) | owid (any grapher slug) | csv (any URL)
Everything runs in GitHub Actions — the dev sandbox cannot reach these hosts.

sources.name: cattle-herd
sources.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head), via Our World in Data
sources.note: annual; national totals, all cattle

sources.name: us-prices
sources.source: BLS producer price indexes via FRED, plus CPI for deflating
sources.note: PPI levels are index numbers (1982=100) — ratios only, never quantities

sources.name: eu-vet-expenses
sources.source: Eurostat Economic Accounts for Agriculture, veterinary expenses
sources.note: ALL livestock, not cattle only — do not present as a per-cattle figure without saying so

sources.name: eu-hicp
sources.source: Euro area HICP via FRED — deflator for any EUR money series

sources.name: us-cowcalf-costs
sources.source: USDA ERS commodity costs and returns, cow-calf
sources.note: SURVEY BASIS CHANGED IN 2008 — do not compare across that break

sources.name: eu-herd-countries
sources.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head) by EU member state, via Our World in Data
sources.note: dairy and beef combined, same limitation as the aggregate

sources.name: eu-vet-countries
sources.source: Eurostat EAA veterinary expenses by member state, million EUR, ALL livestock
sources.note: all livestock, not cattle only

sources.name: broiler-price-fao
sources.source: FAOSTAT bulk producer prices, meat of chickens, USD/tonne (element 5532)
sources.note: query API is 401; bulk zip is public. All countries kept — coverage check

sources.name: feed-maize-fao
sources.source: FAOSTAT bulk producer prices, maize (corn), USD/tonne (element 5532)
sources.note: query API is 401; bulk zip is public. All countries kept — coverage check

sources.name: feed-wheat-fao
sources.source: FAOSTAT bulk producer prices, wheat, USD/tonne (element 5532)
sources.note: query API is 401; bulk zip is public. All countries kept — coverage check

sources.name: pl-agri-out-idx
sources.source: Eurostat quarterly agricultural output price index (2020=100), Poland
sources.note: monthly does not exist - quarterly is the finest Eurostat offers; discover for poultry product code

sources.name: pl-agri-in-idx
sources.source: Eurostat quarterly agricultural input price index (2020=100), Poland
sources.note: discover for feedingstuffs product code

sources.name: world-meat-feed
sources.source: IMF global commodity prices via FRED: poultry, corn, soybean meal, wheat
sources.note: monthly; the import-parity benchmark for feed-importing markets (Gulf)

sources.name: pl-out-idx-15
sources.source: Eurostat quarterly output price index 2015=100, Poland (existence check)

sources.name: broiler-price-fao-bio

filters.Item: Meat of chickens, fresh or chilled (biological)

sources.source: FAOSTAT producer prices, meat of chickens (biological/live-weight basis), USD/tonne
sources.note: PL, IQ, JO and post-2012 TR report on this basis - NOT level-comparable with the carcass item

sources.name: pl-broiler-weekly
sources.source: EC agri-food data portal, weekly broiler prices, Poland (EUR/100kg)
sources.note: EUR/100kg; use 'Whole broiler (65%)' - the standard carcass quotation

sources.name: pl-feed-weekly
sources.source: EC agri-food data portal, weekly cereal prices, Poland (EUR/t)
sources.note: EUR/tonne; decimal-comma prices; pick Feed wheat / Maize series locally

sources.name: tr-evds-catalog
sources.source: EVDS category catalogue (discovery only)
sources.note: all EVDS datagroups; looking for CPI item average prices (tavuk eti) and detailed Tarim-UFE

sources.name: tr-evds-categories
sources.source: EVDS category list (discovery only)

sources.name: tr-meat-feed-ppi
sources.source: TCMB EVDS / TUIK Yi-UFE: meat products PPI (T17), prepared animal feeds PPI (T25)
sources.note: monthly, current; same pair the cattle study used - meat side is ALL meat, not broiler-specific
